chats.answer:
For a hog trap camera with remote trigger, you'll want a cellular camera system that lets you watch wild hogs live and remotely activate a trap gate from your phone.

The important distinction is that most cellular trail cameras only send pictures or videos. They cannot remotely trigger a trap. You need a camera with an integrated gate-control system or a compatible remote-release controller.

Look for these features:

Live video viewing through a smartphone app

Remote trap-gate release

4G LTE cellular connectivity

Night vision for monitoring hogs after dark

Solar power or an external battery for long-term operation

Three systems worth considering
